early.name: Torment Pulse
early.annotation: Yes. You need to get this early game. Really good for farming and dealing some extra damage when you are pushing with your Aura of Suffering.

early.name: Healing Booster
early.annotation: To enhance your healing even further.

mid.name: Fleetfoot
mid.annotation: Really good for chasing early with your 3.

mid.name: Infuser
mid.annotation: The most important item of this build. Insane survivability. Before activating your Aura and jumping in a fight make sure to always activate Infuser.

mid.name: Escalating Exposure
mid.annotation: Insane DoT with your Aura of Suffering.

mid.name: Rapid Recharge
mid.annotation: Once your 2 is maxed, you get 4 charges with each charge having a CD of 14.2s, and 5.6s delay between each charge activation.

mid.name: Warp Stone
mid.annotation: If you are not able to get out of fights or not able to chase your opponents.

late.name: Greater Expansion
late.annotation: Even more range for your 1, 3 and 4.

late.name: Ethereal Shift
late.annotation: When the enemy has become super fed and you are not able to tank efficiently.

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: More damage for all your abilities.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: For getting your 1 and Ult back as soon as possible. Once you have maxed your ult then wth T.CD you get your ult back in 109s.

late.name: Refresher
late.annotation: Key item of Victor. Your survivability goes through the roof.

late.name: Juggernaut
late.annotation: If you have extra souls at this point.
